# Serenity Notes

> Privacy-first productivity app combining task management, journaling, and AI insights

## Description

Serenity Notes is a comprehensive productivity application that helps users manage tasks, track journal entries, and gain AI-powered insights into their productivity patterns. Built with privacy as a core principle, it offers end-to-end encryption, self-hosted deployment options, and offline-first functionality.

## Features

### Core Functionality
- **Task Management**: Organize tasks with projects, priorities, tags, and due dates. Support for subtasks, recurring tasks, and smart scheduling.
- **Journaling**: Daily journaling with rich text formatting, mood tracking, and reflection prompts.
- **AI Insights**: Productivity pattern analysis powered by Anthropic Claude and OpenAI GPT-4. Identifies trends, suggests improvements, and tracks goal progress.
- **Goal Tracking**: Set and monitor long-term goals with progress visualization and milestone tracking.
- **Analytics**: Comprehensive productivity metrics with charts and trend analysis.

### Privacy & Security
- **End-to-end Encryption**: All sensitive data encrypted with user-controlled master password.
- **Self-hosted**: Deploy on your own infrastructure for complete data control.
- **Offline-first**: Desktop app works completely offline with local SQLite database.
- **Zero-knowledge Architecture**: Server never has access to unencrypted user data.

### Integrations
- **Google Calendar**: Bidirectional sync with calendar events and tasks.
- **GitHub**: Track issues, pull requests, and development activity.
- **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**: Extensible integration framework for AI assistants.

## Technology Stack

### Desktop Application
- **Framework**: Electron (cross-platform)
- **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit
- **Database**: SQLite (better-sqlite3)
- **Platforms**: macOS (available), Windows (coming soon), Linux (planned)

### Web Application
- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js with OAuth (Google, GitHub)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL (production), SQLite (development)
- **Deployment**: Self-hosted or cloud platforms (Vercel, Netlify)

### Architecture
- **Monorepo**: Turborepo with shared packages (@serenity/core, @serenity/ui, @serenity/database)
- **AI Services**: Modular architecture supporting multiple AI providers
- **IPC Communication**: Secure Electron IPC with middleware-based validation

### AI Capabilities
- **Providers**: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4
- **Features**: Context-aware prompts, incremental analysis, theme tracking, quality scoring
- **Analysis Modes**: Incremental (new data only), Window (date ranges), Full (complete re-analysis)

## Use Cases

1. **Personal Productivity**: Individuals managing daily tasks, journaling, and personal goals
2. **Self-hosted Privacy**: Users who require complete data ownership and control
3. **AI-assisted Planning**: Leveraging AI insights to improve productivity habits
4. **Cross-platform Workflow**: Seamless sync between desktop and web applications
5. **Developer Productivity**: GitHub integration for tracking development work alongside personal tasks
